$meta.assumption: Brand colours follow the Onam Cloud orange / black / white direction supplied by the client. The exact orange is a proposed value pending the official kit - replace `palettes.*` to adopt it and every artboard reskins with no template edits.
$meta.rule: Orange, black and white only. No fourth hue anywhere in the system.

ember.label: Ember
ember.story: The house system. Near-black ground, one orange ramp running through it, white for the editorial field. Default for everything unless there is a reason.

ignition.label: Ignition
ignition.story: Deeper, redder orange. Higher urgency - launches, migration deadlines, anything with a clock on it.

amber.label: Amber
amber.story: Warmer and goldier. Softer register - culture posts, hiring, festival and Onam-season creative.

rules: Display face carries headlines only. Never set body copy in Space Grotesk.
Headline tracking is negative (-0.03em) at large sizes, neutral below 3rem.
Eyebrow / kicker text is uppercase Inter 600 at 0.16em tracking.
Never more than 3 type sizes on one artboard.

motifs.contour: Concentric rounded-rect contours radiating from a node. The house pattern. Low opacity, always anchored off-canvas.
motifs.nodeGrid: Sparse dot matrix with 2-3 illuminated, connected nodes. Signals network and edge.
motifs.cut: Signature 12-degree diagonal separating the accent field from the ink field. Always top-left to bottom-right.
motifs.aperture: Rounded square frame with one corner squared to 0px. Used for logo lockups, avatars and imagery.

gridRhythm.note: Instagram profile grid reads as a designed surface only if archetypes cycle. Post in this order and the grid forms a diagonal rhythm on its own.
gridRhythm.STATEMENT: Ink field. One huge sentence. Accent underline. Zero decoration beyond the contour motif.
gridRhythm.DATA: Accent field. One number at extreme scale. Ink type. Contour motif in aInk.
gridRhythm.INSIGHT: Paper field. Editorial: eyebrow, headline, 2-line standfirst, rule, byline. Ink type, accent rule.

voice.register: Confident operator, not vendor. Specific over superlative. Onam Cloud connects Indian businesses privately to Azure, AWS and GCP over Equinix - talk about what that removes, not what it adds.
voice.numbers: Always Indian numbering where the audience is domestic (crore/lakh), international format for global posts. State the basis of any metric.
